headline.text: ALO was 0.488 s slower than VER over the lap, losing the most in Sector 3 (0.272 s).

biggest_time_loss.text: Turn 16: ALO lost 0.176 s (carried 14.1 km/h less minimum speed; exited 6.7 km/h slower).
Turn 15: ALO lost 0.112 s (carried 6.0 km/h less minimum speed).
Turn 6: ALO lost 0.098 s (reached full throttle 0.567 s later; exited 7.3 km/h slower), despite braking 5.0 m later.

Turn 1: ALO gained 0.059 s (braked 9.0 m later; exited 5.4 km/h faster).
Turn 11: ALO gained 0.046 s (braked 16.0 m later).
